name: Mahoromatic Moetto ≠ Kirakira Maid-san
original_name: まほろまてぃっく 萌っと≠きらきらメイドさん
source: Based on Mahoromatic manga and anime, this visual novel features a battle android, Mahoro, as the protagonist. Troubled by her past actions during the war, she decides to work as a maid and for none other than the son of her former commander. While the main part of the story functions as a visual novel, the game also features various mini-games and action elements that forward the story. The game also has a gallery with unlockable CG events. [Description from https://www.mobygames.com/game/138098/mahoromatic-moetto-kirakira-maid-san/]
translation: 這部視覺小說改編自漫畫與動畫《魔力女管家》，以戰鬥機器人麻幌為主角。戰爭年代的所作所為令她深感不安，於是她決定去做女僕，而她要侍奉的正是昔日指揮官的兒子。遊戲的主體採用視覺小說的形式，同時穿插了推進故事的小遊戲和動作環節，還設有可解鎖事件CG的鑑賞模式。［簡介取自https://www.mobygames.com/game/138098/mahoromatic-moetto-kirakira-maid-san/］
